title: Suspected intrusion
description: A camera goes offline before a restricted-area door is forced open in the same zone.

title: Suspected tampering and intrusion
description: Camera loss and controller loss precede a forced door opening in the same restricted zone.

title: Escalated access attempt
description: Three denied access attempts precede a forced opening in the same restricted zone.

title: After-hours unauthorized entry
description: Motion follows an unverified door opening in the same restricted zone outside staffed hours.
